description: List connected displays with their current layout (resolution, position, rotation, scaling) and optionally apply a pre-configured display layout by name. Requires displayplacer CLI (brew install jakehilborn/jakehilborn/displayplacer). Layouts are pre-configured in the MACOS_DISPLAY_LAYOUTS environment variable as a JSON object mapping names to displayplacer argument strings. Layout application only accepts named presets — raw displayplacer args are never accepted from the user.

action.description: list — enumerate connected displays; apply_layout — activate a saved layout.

layout_name.description: Name of the display layout to apply for action=apply_layout. Must match a key in MACOS_DISPLAY_LAYOUTS.

name: macos_manage_displays

current_config.description: The current displayplacer command that would reproduce the active arrangement. Present for action=list.

displays.description: Connected display inventory. Present for action=list.

items.description: Connected display with its current layout configuration.

enabled.description: True when the display is active.

id.description: Persistent display identifier assigned by macOS.

origin.description: Position origin in the global display arrangement, e.g. "(0,0)".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `displayplacer_not_found`: displayplacer CLI is not installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/displayplacer. `layout_not_found`: The named layout does not exist in the MACOS_DISPLAY_LAYOUTS server config. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

layout_name.description: Name of the layout that was applied. Present for action=apply_layout.

success.description: True when the layout was applied. Present for action=apply_layout.

title: Manage macOS Displays
